protocol.title: PE beads · Exp 10 · MESF calibration of the bead standard
protocol.summary: Put every capture bead on the MESF scale: the Quantum R-PE MESF beads, read in the same mode on the same plate, give MESF per unit of signal; the conjugate's PE per antibody turns MESF into captured analyte; saturation wells give the capture-site spread.

children.body: The MESF beads are the calibration beads of the ELISA bead standard: one MESF scale for every plate and session.

attrs.title: MESF calibration of the bead standard

chips.text: ≈2 h first time; the MESF wells on every plate

children.body: Pins: MESF per unit of integrated signal in each mode (the session calibration, signal → MESF); MESF per capture bead along the standard curve (Exp 12 then fixes concentration → MESF once per analyte and lot, and its inverse reads samples); PE per detection antibody; the capture-site number per bead and its bead-to-bead CV, which sets beads per well.

Read the MESF beads exactly as the capture beads: the same objective, pinhole, laser %, HV, dwell, pixel and plane rule, on the same plate. If they differ in size or in where the PE sits (a surface shell or the whole volume), transfer the calibration with the simulator (render both with their radius and label geometry) or read the MESF wells as a 5-plane sum, which removes the geometry dependence. MESF assumes a bead and a solution behave alike; keep a flow-cytometry cross-check when one is available.

rows.free_text: Quantum R-PE MESF beads (Bangs): blank + 4 levels, lot MESF values from the certificate
Capture beads at saturating analyte + saturating PE-detection antibody, 2 h, washed (site distribution)
UV-vis spectrophotometer or NanoDrop for the conjugate A565 and A280 (or the reagent lot's F/P ratio)

outputs.name: analyte_bead
outputs.label: Captured, labelled analyte per bead (one MESF ≈ one PE)

inputs.name: se_pct
inputs.label: Target standard error of the well median

children.body: A bead at [!var:f_bead] is [!var:mesf_bead] ([!var:mesf_um2]), i.e. [!var:analyte_bead] labelled analyte molecules at [!var:n_pe] PE per IgG. At [!var:cv_pct] CV, analyse [!var:n_beads] beads per well.
Measure A565 and A280 of the PE-antibody conjugate (blank on its buffer), or take the F/P ratio from the reagent lot sheet.
Resuspend the MESF beads as the kit says; one well per level plus the blank, on the same plate as the capture beads.
Run two saturation wells: capture beads with analyte at the top of the expected range × 10 and PE-antibody at ≥ 10× its K_D, 2 h with mixing, washed.
Settle with a 1 min plate spin. Image every well in the default mode at the Exp 01 laser %, ≥ 100 beads per well. Repeat the MESF wells as a 5-plane sum (2 µm steps around the equator).
On every later plate: the MESF wells (≥ 30 beads per level) at the start and the end. They are the plate's calibration and the Exp 01 power check in one read.

Before any quantitative acquisition: stand and lasers on for 2–3 h; 561 nm excitation; the same PE emission band (e.g. 570–620 nm) every time; 16-bit with fine integration (the default is 12-bit, so check the file); one HV and one offset for the whole session; background mode at least 50 DN above zero; no saturated pixels. Record the transmitted-light channel with every PE frame: beads are found in it, never in PE. Find focus in transmitted light and hold it with Perfect Focus. Never live-scan PE to focus.
Fit integrated signal against the lot MESF per level (linear, intercept at the blank). The slope is DN per MESF for this mode and plate. Check linearity across the four levels.
If the MESF beads and the capture beads differ in size or label geometry, transfer with the simulator, or use the 5-plane-sum slope.
Capture beads: MESF per bead; with PE per antibody (one MESF ≈ one PE on the bead), labelled analyte per bead.
Saturation wells: the MESF-per-bead distribution. Subtract the photon-noise variance (≈ mean in photoelectrons, Exp 02) from the observed variance; the remainder is the capture-site CV.
Cross-check when a flow cytometer is available: the same MESF beads and capture beads, with no focus, refraction or field effects. The two MESF scales should agree within ≈15 %.

Decision: each plate is converted with its own MESF wells; the beads per well; whether the capture-site CV is acceptable. Exp 12 reports the standard curve in MESF per bead, so one curve per analyte and lot serves every plate.

rows.note: DN per MESF at the start and the end

children.body: Save the .nd2 files as acquired (no 8-bit export, no LUT) in a folder outside the website repo, e.g. BeadConfocalData/<date>_<exp>/, and fill one plate-map CSV row per well or field (columns are listed in Research/PE_bead_confocal_experiments.md, section 7).
